These labels are then utilized to train the smaller “student” model which will actually be deployed. Common methods to address these downstream issues, such as adversarial training, are In this work, we address the core issue of excess non-linearity via curvature, and This leads to improved robustness and stable gradients, at a fraction of the cost of standard adversarial training. To achieve this, we decompose overall model curvature in terms of curvatures and slopes of its constituent layers. Our experiments show that LCNNs have lower curvature, more stable gradients and increased off-the-shelf adversarial robustness when compared to standard neural networks, all without affecting predictive performance.
